articles.summary: Long-term survival of patients in the 123-patient Phase 1b CRC cohort was not limited to patients with favorable baseline characteristics, suggesting durable benefit may extend across a broader patient population Approximately 1 in 4 long-term survivors were alive and off all cancer therapy at last follow-up, with responses lasting more than three years Patients with fewer prior lines of treatment were more likely to achieve long-term survival, supporting rationale for BOT+BAL earlier in the course of treatment Agenus Inc. (Nasdaq: AGEN) , a leader in immuno-oncology innovation, today announced new findings from a long-term survivor analysis of its Phase 1b C-800-01 trial evaluating botensilimab (BOT), a multifunctional, Fc-enhanced anti-CTLA-4 antibody, in combination with balstilimab (BAL), an anti-PD-1 antibody, in heavily pretreated patients with microsatellite-stable (MSS) metastatic colorectal cancer (mCRC) without active liver metastases. The results were presented in a poster
articles.title: Agenus Reports More Than Half of Patients with Refractory MSS Metastatic Colorectal Cancer Achieved Long-Term Survival Following BOT+BAL Treatment at SITC 2026

articles.title: Agenus Reports Third Quarter 2026 Results, Highlighted by First Marketing Authorizations for BOT+BAL and Global Investigator Support for Phase 3 ROBBIN Study

articles.summary: In pMMR/MSS colon cancer, neoadjuvant BOT+BAL met the trial’s primary endpoint with a 36% major pathologic response rate, including 29% pathologic complete response, within an overall 71% pathologic response rate after one BOT dose and two BAL doses No patients treated with BOT+BAL had their cancer return, with median follow-up of 19.2 months in MSS disease and 16.7 months in MSI-H disease; 12-month event-free survival was 100% in both combination cohorts. Independent, multicenter UNICORN findings reinforce the NEST peer-reviewed neoadjuvant evidence supporting Agenus’ planned Phase 3 ROBBIN trial in curative-intent MSS/pMMR colon cancer Agenus Inc. (Nasdaq: AGEN) , a leader in immuno-oncology innovation, today announced the peer-reviewed publication of results from the investigator-sponsored, multicenter Phase 2 UNICORN trial evaluating short-course preoperative, or neoadjuvant, botensilimab (BOT), Agenus’ multifunctional, Fc-enhanced anti-CTLA-4 antibody, alone or in combination
articles.title: Agenus Announces Nature Medicine Publication of Multicenter UNICORN Phase 2 Trial Demonstrating Deep Responses with Neoadjuvant BOT+BAL in Resectable Colon Cancer

articles.summary: Agenus Inc. (Nasdaq: AGEN) , a leader in immuno-oncology innovation, today announced that Robin Taylor, Chief Commercial Officer, and Zack Armen, Vice President of Corporate Development and Investor Relations, will participate in a virtual fireside chat hosted by Rodman Renshaw on Thursday, November 5, 2026. The discussion will be moderated by Michael G. King, Jr., Senior Biotechnology Analyst and will focus on the development of botensilimab (BOT) and balstilimab (BAL), including neoadjuvant colon cancer results from NEST, UNICORN and NEOASIS, and the planned Phase 3 ROBBIN trial. Management will also discuss strategic priorities, funding and the commercial opportunity for BOT+BAL. Rodman Renshaw Virtual Fireside Chat Date: Thursday, November 5, 2026 Time: 11:30 a.m. to 12:30 p.m. ET Format: Virtual Registration: Register here About Agenus Agenus is a leading immuno-oncology company targeting cancer with a comprehensive pipeline of immunological agents.
articles.title: Agenus to Participate in Rodman & Renshaw Virtual Fireside Chat
